pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, calm and reflective atmosphere)

A quiet light
rising slowly
in the open sky

[Verse 1]
The darkest hour
falls behind the wind
like broken shadows
fading out of sight

I take a deeper breath
the air feels wide
and somewhere in my back
the wings unfold

[Chorus]
I open my wings
toward the quiet sky
letting the wind
carry the rest

Clouds move slowly
under my feet
the world below
growing small

I am already
somewhere higher

[Verse 2]
Tears drift away
into the passing air
what stays behind
is only light

Once the wings open
they remember the sky
and the silence
that holds them there

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, cinematic and flowing)

[Bridge]
The sky calls softly
as if it always knew

this moment
would arrive

A quiet voice
standing beside me
saying
you are ready now

[Chorus]
I open my wings
a little wider

the sky ahead
still unfolding

Step by step
through moving clouds

I follow the air
without looking back

Already flying
through the open blue

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, warm fading notes)

The wind grows quiet
around the wings

And somewhere
in this endless sky

I keep moving
forward
